reviews.name: 정****
reviews.content:
둘째가 엄청좋아하네요 ㅋㅋ 
앞발로 눌러서 야무지게 씹고 
무아지경에 빠졌어요. .ㅎㅎ
너무 귀여워서 잘샀구나 싶어요~
reviews.content_en: Our second one really loves it haha 😂 He presses it with his front paws and chews on it so well, he's totally obsessed with it ㅎㅎ I'm so glad we bought it, it's adorable~

reviews.name: 조****
reviews.content: 가끔씩 씹는거를 엄청 찾아가지고 우피껌을 종종 사주는데 항상 잘 먹어용 ㅋㅋ 이가 튼튼해가지고 너무 금방 다 먹어버려서 중간에 뺏어서 다음에주기도하는데 이거는 그냥 다 먹어도 괜찮을 사이즈 인것 같아요 다먹으면 또 구매해볼게요!!!
reviews.content_en: He sometimes looks for chews like crazy, so I often give him UPIGGUM and he always eats it well lol 😂 His teeth are so strong that he finishes it really quickly, so sometimes I take it away and give it to him later, but this one seems to be a size where he can eat the whole thing. I'll buy it again once he finishes it!!!

reviews.name: 토****
reviews.content: 아이들이 좋아해서 재구매했습니다. 한녀석은 숨기는 재미가 먹는 재미보다 큰듯 하네요.
reviews.content_en: The kids love it so we repurchased. One of them enjoys hiding it more than eating it.

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 딱딱한걸 좋아해서 자주 주고 있어요 :)
reviews.content_en: He likes hard treats so I give them to him often :)

reviews.name: 민****
reviews.content:
냄새가 무향이라 그런지 간식을 줘도 냄새 맡더니 관심이 없어해여…
그치만 맛을 보더니 오래 잘 먹는거같아여
reviews.content_en: Since it has no scent, even when I give him the treat, he sniffs it but doesn't seem interested… However, once he tastes it, he seems to eat it well for a long time

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content:
어금니없어서 그런지 오~~~래 탈없이 잘먹어서 재구매했어요 
예전같음 하루컷인데ㅋ맘 아프네요ㅠㅠ
reviews.content_en: Because he has no molars, he chews on it well without any issues for a long time, so I repurchased it. It used to be a one-day thing before ㅋ My heart aches ㅠㅠ

reviews.name: 장****
reviews.content:
잡고뜯고맛보고씹고
먹기싫으면 숨겨두고 다시 생각나면 후식껌처럼 먹는 그런맛
reviews.content_en: Hold it, tear it, taste it, chew it, and if he doesn't feel like eating, he hides it and eats it later like dessert gum

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content: 우리집 강아지 최애간식 되었어요 유모차타고 산책 연습시키고 있는데 유모차안에서 난리가나요 ㅠㅠ 뛰쳐나가려고 ㅠㅠ 무슨 간식이라도 오래씹는걸로 유모차태워보자 해서 우피껌 더블 롤리츄 주문했는데 ㅎㅎ 완전 잘씹고 너무 좋아해요 우피껌으로 계속 유모차 산책연습시킬거에요 성공!!
reviews.content_en: It became my pup's favorite treat! 😂 We're practicing stroller walks, and he's going crazy inside the stroller ㅠㅠ trying to jump out ㅠㅠ So I thought let's try long-lasting chews in the stroller, and I ordered UPIGGUM Double Lollychew ㅎㅎ He chews it so well and loves it! I'll keep using UPIGGUM Double Lollychew for stroller walk practice. Success!!

reviews.name: 양****
reviews.content:
연필같이 생긴 우피껌은 먹다가 목 찔릴때도 있고, 비교적 얇아서 그런지 끝부분을 삼켜버린적 있어서 폴드형태만 사주는데 이것도 역시 잘 먹네요! 

3kg 강아지인데, 2-3일을 먹어도 반도 못먹습니다 ㅎㅎ 그때쯤 더러워지고 짧아져서 새걸로 교체해줘요
reviews.content_en: The pencil-shaped UPIGGUM can sometimes poke the throat while eating, and since it's relatively thin, he's swallowed the end before, so I only give him the fold type now, and he eats this well too! He's a 3kg pup, and even after eating for 2-3 days, he can't finish half of it ㅎㅎ By then it gets dirty and shorter, so I replace it with a new one

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content: 오래 먹는다는 동결건조 간식 구매했을때도 15분컷이라 오래 먹고 성분 믿을만한 간식이 없었는데 아기가 너무 조아하구 오래 먹어서 만족해요🩵💛
reviews.content_en: When I bought freeze-dried treats that were supposed to last long, they only lasted 15 minutes, and I couldn't find treats with trustworthy ingredients, but my baby loves this one so much and eats it for a long time, so I'm satisfied 🩵💛

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
장난감도 다 뜯어버리는 파괴왕이라
오래먹는 껌들 찾아서 이것 저것 사서 먹여봤는데
10분도 못가는 껌들이 많아서
오래먹는 껌 유목민이였어요 😭

더블 롤리츄는 처음 급여해보니 냄새 맡고
좋은지 가지고 놀다가 손으로 잡고 씹고 잘먹어요! 

13키로 코기 1시간은 씹고 뜯고 맛보고
가지고 놀기도 하네요! 

아주 만족입니당 👍
reviews.content_en: Being a destructive king who tears up all toys, I tried finding and buying long-lasting chews here and there, but many of them don't last even 10 minutes, so I was a long-lasting chew nomad 😭 When I first gave Double Lollychew, he smells it, plays with it a bit, then grabs and chews it well! A 13kg Corgi chews, tears, tastes, and plays with it for over an hour! Very satisfied 👍

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content:
제일 중요하게 보는 것은 최대한 원물 그대로를 살리는지, 국내산 믿을만한 공정을 거치는지!  기호성과 편의성은 당연🤗🤗 맛있어보이려고 억지가공을 하진 않는지 등입니다. 

그런의미에서 더블 롤리츄는 최고네요!😝

일주일에 한번 7시간을 둘만 있어야 하는 강아지들인데 아직 어린 강아지들이라 넘 심심할 거에요~ 일반 껌 여러가지 바꿔서 줘봤지만 애들이 쑥쑥 크는지 순삭을 해버립니다!!

5분 아주 길어야 10분 컷ㅠㅠ

그런데 더블 롤리츄는 하나 가지고 반나절을 노네요!!
포메 3.7kg 두마리인데 한마리는 3시간 한마리는 반나절이 지난 지금도 다 못먹고 가지고 놀고 있어요~~

품에 꼭 안고 낮잠도 1시간 자고 또 일어나서 먹고 산책 1시간 다녀와서 숨겨둔 롤리츄 또 갖고 와서 먹네요!!

이만하면 우드스틱 저리가랏😎😎

기호성도 좋고 무표백제 무방부제 치아건강에 도움고 되는데다 치석제거에 스트레스 해소까지!! 

최고 간식 이네요😘😘
reviews.content_en: The most important thing I look for is whether it preserves the original ingredients as much as possible and goes through trustworthy domestic processing! Palatability and convenience are obviously important 🤗🤗 And whether it's forcefully processed just to look delicious, etc. In that sense, Double Lollychew is the best! 😝 I have puppies that need to be alone for 7 hours once a week, and since they're still young puppies, they must get so bored~ I've tried switching between various regular chews, but as the kids grow, they finish them instantly!! Just 5 minutes, max 10 minutes ㅠㅠ But Double Lollychew, they play with just one for half a day!! I have two Pomeranians at 3.7kg each, one eats it for 3 hours and the other still hasn't finished after half a day and is playing with it~~ They even cuddle it, nap for 1 hour, wake up and eat, come back from a 1-hour walk and bring out the hidden Lollychew and eat it again!! At this point, goodbye rawhide sticks 😎😎 Good palatability, bleach-free, preservative-free, helps with dental health, and also helps with tartar removal and stress relief!! It's the best treat 😘😘

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
중형견도 오래먹는 더블 롤리츄 (≧∇≦)/
단백질+덴탈 조합이면 아묻따 구매해야죠 … 🤤💛
저희 반려견이 우피를 좋아하는데 너무 잘 먹어서 뿌듯합니다 🐮
아무리 딱딱한 간식이라도 빨리 먹는 타입인데 롤리츄는 20분 넘게 걸린 것 같아요 ! 🤔
reviews.content_en: Medium-sized dogs also get a long-lasting Double Lollychew (≧∇≦)/ A protein+dental combo? Obviously gotta buy it... 🤤💛 Our pup loves UPIGGUM and eats it so well, it makes me proud 🐮 Even with the hardest treats, he eats quickly, but Lollychew took over 20 minutes! 🤔

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
저희 로키가 애정하는 바잇미 롤리츄가 새로운 라인업으로 기존 롤리츄보다 2배 큰 우피를 사용해서 더 오래 먹을 수 있는 한우 우피껌이 나왔더라구요 !!🥺
기존 롤리츄는 사이즈가 작아 아무래도 저희 로키는 빨리 먹는다는게 아쉬웠는데 이렇게 중형견 친구들도 오래 먹을 수 있도록 만들어주셔서 무한 감동 💗😊
그리고 더블 롤리츄는 무표백제와 무방부제를 사용하여 안심하고 급여할 수 있고 치석제거와 스트레스 해소까지 도와주니 더 손가더라구요 !! 손으로 잡고 먹으면서 재밌게 먹는거같기도하구요 !!
다른 강아지껌과는 다르게 한우 암소 우피만을 사용하고 HACCP 인증되어 가공과정에 대해 신뢰할 수 있었어요 😯
그럴때 있잖아요 맛있는거 먹고 있는데 옆에서 쳐다보면 혼자먹기 그런거.. 그럴때 하나씩 쥐어주면 미안한 마음없이 편하게 식사할 수 있게 됩니다 😅 
‘바잇미 더 오래 먹는 우피껌 더블 롤리츄’ 추천드려요 ♥
reviews.content_en: Rocky loves BITE ME Lollychew, and I found out they released a new lineup with BITE ME Double Lollychew using 2x bigger UPIGGUM than the existing Lollychew so he can eat it for longer 🥺!! The existing Lollychew was small size so it was a shame that Rocky ate it quickly, but I'm infinitely touched that you made it so medium-sized friends can also eat it longer 💗😊 And Double Lollychew uses no bleach and no preservatives so you can feed it with confidence, and it helps with tartar removal and stress relief too, so I like it even more !! He seems to have fun eating it while holding it in his paws !! Unlike other dog chews, it only uses Korean beef cow rawhide and is HACCP certified so I could trust the processing ☺️ You know how sometimes when you're eating something delicious and they stare at you from the side, it feels bad to eat alone.. When you give them one each, they can eat comfortably without feeling sorry 😅 I recommend 'BITE ME Double Lollychew - The Long-Lasting Rawhide Chew' ♥

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
🩷맘에 들었던 더블 롤리츄의 장점🩷
-국내 HACCP 인증 시설에서 생산
-방부제, 표백제, 발색제, 인공첨가물 🙅🏻‍♀️
-2배 더 오래 먹는 "한우" 우피껌
-스트레스 해소에 탁월
-SHMP 첨가로 치아건강 🆙️

🩷찐후기🩷
시간을 재보고 싶었는데 시간을 잴 수 없을 만큼 오래 먹었어요! 쉬다가 먹고 산책 다녀와서 먹고! 잊지 않고 찾아먹을 정도로 기호성도 있더라구요 저는 그 개껌의 특유의 인공적인 냄새를 싫어해서 껌은 덴탈껌 말고는 사주지 않는데 그 특유의 냄새도 나지 않고 첨가물이 다 빠져서 그런지 오히려 맛있는 갈비탕 냄새가 나더라구요☺️ 맛도 있고 믿을 수 있고 치아 케어도 가능해서 계속 내돈내산 할 거 같아요!
reviews.content_en: 🩷The advantages of Double Lollychew that I liked🩷 -Produced at domestic HACCP certified facility -No preservatives, bleach, coloring agents, artificial additives 🙅🏻‍♀️ -'Korean beef' rawhide chew that lasts 2x longer -Excellent for stress relief -Helps with dental health with SHMP addition 🆙️ 🩷Real review🩷 I wanted to time it but it lasted so long I couldn't time it! Eating after resting, eating after walks! He looks for it without forgetting, so the palatability is there too. I hate that artificial smell of dog chews, so I don't give chews except for dental chews, but this doesn't have that artificial smell and since all additives are removed, it actually smells like delicious galbi-tang ☺️ Good taste, trustworthy, and can care for teeth, so I think I'll keep buying with my own money!

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
바잇미 더 오래먹는 우피껌 더블 롤리츄 오리지널 급여해 보았어요

향은 더 구수하니 제가 맡아도 좋았구요
무엇보다 한입에 꿀꺽 삼키려는 저희 댕댕이는 간식을 꼭 푸드클립에 끼워주는데 납작해진 형태때문에 딱 고정이 되어 쉽게 빼먹지 못해 야무지게 물고 뜯어 더 오래먹을수 있어 좋았어요
오리지널은 치아에도 도움이 되는 성분이 들어있다니 일석이조네요!!
만족스러운 간식이 또 출시되어 좋아요! 추가구매하러 갑니다😄
reviews.content_en: I tried BITE ME Long-Lasting Rawhide Chew Double Lollychew Original. I used to buy and feed the existing Lollychew, and it was released in a size that's twice bigger than the existing one with a flattened shape! The scent is more savory and even I liked it when I smelled it. Most importantly, my pup who tries to swallow in one bite, I always put treats in a food clip, and because of the flattened shape, it fixes perfectly so he can't steal it easily, and he can chew and tear it more thoroughly and eat it longer, which is great! The original has ingredients that help with teeth too, so it's a win-win!! I'm glad another satisfying treat came out! Going to buy more 😄

reviews.name: 노****
reviews.content:
안녕하세요 이번에 더블 롤리츄 체험단에 당첨되어 저희 강아지에게 급여하게 되었어요!
저희 강아지는 4키로 소형견입니다.

 평소에 껌을 굉장히 좋아하는데요, 더블 롤리츄는 우피껌이라 일단 성분상으로 안전하기 때문에 안심하고 급여할 수 있었어요.

reviews.content_en: Hello! I won a Double Lollychew trial this time and got to feed it to my pup! My pup is a 4kg small breed. Also, while very hard, it becomes soft as the pup chews it and has fun tearing it! Most gums are very hard so while effective for tartar removal, I hesitated because of fracture risk. reviews.content_en: [BITE ME Long-Lasting Rawhide Chew Double Lollychew Original] First trial request and winner review 🩵💛🩷 Oh? They sent two packs 🫶🏻 When the package arrived, I sniffed around thinking they'd eat right away.. Not like the other friends, I couldn't take product advertisement photos 😅 After brushing, tore off one and gave it, and they ran away with it ㅋㅋㅋ The sound is like teeth might break.. Got a bit scared but it's fine! Everything else finishes quick but this lasts forever... I haven't even finished yet ㅠ When eating they hold it side to side and chew, so tartar removal should work well ㅎㅎ The texture is pretty hard but if you're looking for long-lasting dog chews, I recommend it 👍 Always watch well when feeding ☺️

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
사진 좀 찍으려는데 빨리 달라고 봉지 핥고 난리난리😂
성화에 못이겨 얼른 뜯어서 드렸지요.

15분만에 해치웠던 기존 롤리츄와 달리 장장 40분을 씹어 먹고도 반정도 남아서 담요 속에 야무지게 숨겨두고 다음날까지 먹은 껌이 요게 처음입니다.. 감격..🥹

최고품 한우 우피로 만든 국내제조 자연껌! 
기호성은 말해뭐해~ 콜라겐과 엘라스틴이 풍부해 관절과 피부에도 좋다는데 안먹일 이유 없죠?
reviews.content_en: I was trying to take a picture, but Pui kept licking the package and going crazy asking for it ASAP 😂 I couldn't resist and quickly opened it for her. Unlike the regular Lollychew she used to finish in 15 minutes, she chewed on this for a whole 40 minutes and still had about half left, which she cleverly hid under her blanket to eat the next day. This is the first chew she's ever saved! 🥹 Premium Korean beef hide natural chew made domestically! The palatability speaks for itself~ and it's rich in collagen and elastin which is good for joints and skin, so there's no reason not to give it to her!

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
10키로 푸딩이가 오래 먹는간식으로 추천합니다!!!
무슨 간식이던 냠냠뚝딱해버리는 저희 강아지가 20분가까이 먹어요!!
가족끼리 고기먹을때면 난리난리가 나는데 이거하나 물려주니 사람들 식사가 편해졌어요!!ㅋㅋ기존에 작은 롤리츄는 반쯤 먹으면 대충 씹고 꿀꺽해버리곤했는데 이건 그러지 못해서 더더욱 오래 먹을 수 있고 믿을만한 바잇미에서 믿을만한 원료로 만들었으니 만족만족😊
reviews.content_en: Highly recommend this long-lasting treat for our 10kg Pudding! 💕 Our pup usually demolishes any snack in no time, but she's been chewing on this for almost 20 minutes!! When the family eats meat she usually goes crazy, but now we can just give her this and everyone can eat in peace! 😂 With the small Lollychew, she used to half-chew and swallow it quickly, but with this one she can't do that, so she eats it for much longer. And since it's made by trustworthy BITE ME with trustworthy ingredients, we're very satisfied 😊

reviews.name: 윤****
reviews.content: 간식을 너무 빨리 먹어서 오래 먹을 수 있는 간식 찾고 있었는데 아주 딱이에요..♥️ 크기도 적당해서 소형견이 먹어도 충분하더라고요! 포장도 잘되어 있어서 하나 꺼내 먹고 나머지 밀봉도 잘되어서 편리해용 :)
reviews.content_en: I was looking for a long-lasting treat since my pup eats snacks too quickly, and this is absolutely perfect! ♥️ The size is just right so even small dogs have no problem with it! The packaging is great too - I can take out one piece and the rest seals up nicely, which is super convenient :)

reviews.name: 장****
reviews.content:
울 강쥐의 스트레스를 날려줄 우피츄!!ㅋㅋㅋ
전에 동그란 모양으로 된 우피츄 사서 먹었었는데 이번에 납작한 모양의 우피츄가 나왔대서 바로 신청했어요

요즘 이갈이하고 있어서 이가 약간 불편한지 먹다말다 먹다말다 하지만 양발로 야무지게 잡고 편하게 먹습니다 ㅋㅋㅋㅋ

울 강쥐 6.5kg 5개월인데 하나 주면 2-3일은 먹는거 같아요
자기 방석에 두고 심심할때마다 가서 뜯습니다 ㅋ
reviews.content_en: Beef hide chew for our pup's stress relief!! 😂 We bought the round-shaped beef hide chew before, so when we heard they came out with a flat version, we ordered it right away! She's teething right now so her teeth are a bit uncomfortable and she eats on and off, but she comfortably holds it with both paws and chews 😂 Our pup is 6.5kg and 5 months old, and one seems to last her 2-3 days! She leaves it on her bed and goes back to chew on it whenever she's bored 😄

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
포장지가 지퍼팩이라 두고두고 먹일때 급여하기 좋아요!
급여했을때 소형견, 중형견, 대형견 모두 잘 먹어요.
6kg 소형견은 20분을 넘게 먹고, 30kg넘는 대형견도 10분 가까이 먹네요. 초집중해서 먹기때문에 무언가에 집중시킬때 아주 좋은거 같아요 질리지도 않고 야무지게 양손으로 잡고 먹는거 보고있으니 넘나리 귀엽습니다ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: The zippered packaging makes it convenient for feeding over time! Both small, medium, and large breeds eat it well. My 6kg small dog chews for over 20 minutes, and even the large dog over 30kg chews for close to 10 minutes. Since they focus intently on eating, it's great for keeping them occupied on something. They don't get tired of it and watching them hold it with both paws is just so adorable 😊

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
한우 우신잘 먹어서 요건 어떤가 하고 사줬더니
요것도 넘 잘먹네요
일단 한우라 맘에들었죠 
작은 강아지라 그런지
하나로 먹다가 숨겨놨다가 또 찾아서 먹고를 
반복한답니다
언제 다 먹을지 모르지만
다 먹으면 무조건 구매각이에요
reviews.content_en: She really liked the beef hide chew, so I decided to try this one, and she loves this too! First of all, I liked that it's made from Korean beef. Since she's a small dog, she eats one, hides it, finds it again and eats it - she repeats this process. I'm not sure when she'll finish it, but once she does, I'll definitely buy it again!

reviews.content:
대형견들도 생각보다 오래먹어요!
흥분도낮추고, 스케일링 생각하면 좋을거같아요
넘 맛잇게 잘먹더라구요 🖤
reviews.content_en: Even large dogs take longer to eat it than expected! It also helps calm their excitement, and if you're thinking about scaling, I think this would be good for that. She eats it so deliciously 🖤

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content: 껌 종류를 처음 먹어보는 보리는 아직 먹는 방법이 어려워 하루 종일 물고 다니지만 버리지 않는 거 보면 아주 마음에 들어하는 거 같아요!! 하지만 딱딱한 거 처음 급여하시는 분이면 조금 생각하고 구매하시는 걸 추천드립니다! 하지만 맛은 아주 👍🏻
reviews.content_en: Bori is trying chew treats for the first time and still doesn't quite know how to eat it properly - she carries it around all day - but the fact that she doesn't abandon it shows she really loves it! However, if you're giving your dog hard treats for the first time, I'd recommend thinking it over before purchasing! But the taste is absolutely 👍🏻

reviews.name: 진****
reviews.content:
표백제를 쓴 우피가 아니라 더 건강하고
진짜 간식 빨리먹는 강쥐인데 오랫동안 먹어서 너무너무 좋아욥
reviews.content_en: It's not bleached beef hide, so it's healthier. My pup usually eats treats super fast, but she's been able to chew on this for a long time and I love it so much!

reviews.name: 양****
reviews.content: 한동안 많이 사줬더니 잘 안먹더라고요 그래서 좀 텀을 쥬고 사주니 너무 잘 먹어요 씹다가 다른거하다 또 생각나면 묵고 ㅎ
reviews.content_en: I fed it to her a lot for a while and she stopped eating it. But when I gave her a break and offered it again, she started eating it really well! She'll chew on it, do something else, then remember and come back to chew more 😊

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content:
잘먹는가 싶더니 안먹네요.
2키로 포메라니안 이라 작은거 시켰다가
너무 호다닥 먹길래 큰거 시켜봤는데
딱딱한거 싫어하긴 하는데 
첫날만 잘 씹다가 조금 먹구 잘 안먹네요.
어쩌다 가끔 주면 또 조금 씹긴해요.
빠르게 잘 받았습니다.
reviews.content_en: I thought she was eating it well but she's not. She's a 2kg Pomeranian so I tried the small size first and she was eating it so fast, so I ordered the large size. She doesn't like hard things, and after chewing well on just the first day, she barely eats it now. Occasionally when I give it to her, she'll chew a little bit. The delivery was quick though!

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content: 강아지가 엄청 오래씹구 조아하구 가지고놀구 짱짱입니다
reviews.content_en: My dog chews on it for a really long time, loves it, and plays with it - it's the best!

reviews.name: 배****
reviews.content:
무엇을 줘도 순삭인 우리집 똥강아지 배시시
롤리츄는 가지고도 놀고 오래 씹고 최고에요!
잘 깨물지 못해 못먹는다면 잘라서 한번 줘보세요
잘라줘도 일반 간식보다 오래 먹어서 좋아요!
reviews.content_en: Our pup Baeshi usually inhales any treat instantly, but with Lollychew she plays with it and chews for a long time - it's the best! If your dog can't bite it well enough to eat, try cutting it up for them. Even cut up, she chews on it longer than regular treats, which is great!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 쬰쬰 야무지게 잘뜯어 먹어요 배송도 빠르고 포장도 꼼꼼해서 역시 믿주문 바잇미💛
reviews.content_en: She carefully tears into it and eats it so well! Delivery was fast and the packaging was thorough - it's a trusted order from trusted BITE ME 💛

reviews.name: 김****
reviews.content:
좋은 구성과 가격에 구매했어요
덕분에 간식을 엄청 쟁여놓을 수 있었다는!
reviews.content_en: I bought it for the great quality and price. Thanks to that, I was able to stock up on treats!

reviews.name: 노****
reviews.content: 롤리츄를 먹어봤어서 그런가 거부감 없이 주자마자 잘 먹어요 ㅎㅎ 두발로 잡고 어찌나 소중하게 먹던지 진짜 짱귀에요~ 뭐든 순삭인 아이인데 오래 먹었어요!!!! 다먹고 재구매 의사 있오요!!!!
reviews.content_en: Since she's tried Lollychew before, she eats this without hesitation as soon as I give it to her! 😄 The way she holds it with both paws and eats it so carefully is so cute! She's the type to inhale any treat, but she chewed on this for a long time! I plan to repurchase once she finishes!!!

reviews.name: 양****
reviews.content:
잘먹으면서 잘안먹는..? 그런 간식이에욥ㅋㅋ

처음에 꺼내줄때는 난리가 나는데, 15분정도 먹으면 힘든지 내팽겨폈다가 생각나면 뜯고 놀아서 작아지면 버립니당

개껌 종류는 삼킬까봐 불안한데, 오히려 중간에 질려하는(?) 모습에 안심돼서 재주문했습니다 ㅎㅎ
reviews.content_en: It's a weird kind of treat where she eats it well but also doesn't eat it well...? 😂 At first she goes crazy when I take it out, but after about 15 minutes she seems to get tired and tosses it aside, then comes back to nibble and play with it whenever she remembers, and drops it when it gets too small. I was worried about her swallowing dog chews, but seeing her actually lose interest halfway through made me feel better, so I reordered 😊

reviews.name: 조****
reviews.content: 생각보다 오래먹어요 5분..?!! 재구매의사 100%
reviews.content_en: She eats it for longer than expected - 5 minutes...?!! I'll definitely repurchase!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 이갈이 강아지 주려고 샀는데 넘 어려서 딱딱한 건 아직 먹음 안 된다네요~ 생각보다 작은 느낌도 들지만 단단해서 좋아요!
reviews.content_en: I bought it for my teething puppy, but it's a bit too hard for her right now. It feels smaller than expected, but I like that it's sturdy!

reviews.name: 이****
reviews.content: 오래 먹일 수 있고 저희집 댕댕이도 엄청 좋아라해요
reviews.content_en: You can feed it for a long time and our pup absolutely loves it!
